sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be preformed every 
1000 working hours as indicated by H1000 in the title block. (1000HS, 1EA-P001A)

The pump 
supplier KSB Germany type SNW 600-719

The motor type: ANVE-WT001, supplier: 
Teco electric & machinery Co. LTD Taiwan,

المسودة الأولى بدأها المهندس. هاني صموئيل إبراهيم، راجعه م. 
 حمزة حلمي السيد الشافعي اختبار م. محمد الخطيب محمد 
 سالم، قبله المهندس. محمود محمد حسن زايد، معتمد 
 بواسطة المهندس. عبد المجيد عبد القوي عمارة: رئيس قطاع 
 محطة كهرباء سيدى قير.

This document certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC 
 Engineering consultant A and MPIS coordinator.
احتياطات السلامة
يجب إصدار تصريح العمل.

The qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution works surrounding the work area is required
ارتداء معدات السلامة والصحة مثل خوذة السلامة وأحذية السلامة ... الخ
Isolate the pump mechanically and the motor electrically

Be sure the motor of the pump is stopped and its breaker isolated before 
 starting any maintenance.

Electrical Isolation:
- Circuit breaker 1NB011 is opened
 - Switch off the DC Supply
 - Space heater 9NHA 31A- ICH-26 is open

Mechanical Isolation:
- Close the discharge valve 1EA-V001A

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Ensure the oil viscosity, 
acid no., contamination for thrust bearings (pump and motor)

Ensure the grease Mobile 
plex 47 for lower bearing of motor.

Check the tighten for all 
bolts of the pump and motor.

Clean the cooling water 
pipes of thrust bearing (pump and motor)

فحص جميع الصمامات (المصارف، 
تنفيس، ... الخ)

Generally clean the 
external pump body

Check the packing ( 4 
pieces, 95x127x16mm, RT-P) and shaft protecting sleeve

Check the rubber (8 
pieces, No. 315)
